caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a wooden case painted in a reddish-brown color. The clock is vertically oriented and consists of three main sections: a wide base with curved feet, a tall, slim central cabinet with a door, and an ornate arched top housing the clock face. The base and central cabinet are rectangular, while the top section features a decorative curved pediment with a central finial and two symmetrical scrolls. The clock face occupies the uppermost section, displaying black hour and minute hands, black numerals in two concentric circles (hours 1-12 and 13-24), and additional markings, with floral and green leaf accents at each corner of the face. Above the main clock face, within the arch, is a semicircular area with a small, colorful floral motif. The majority of the detailed ornamentation is concentrated in the upper section of the clock, while the lower portion is plain, with subtle wood grain shading. The overall background of the image is a plain, light beige color.
title: Hall Clock (Grandfather's Clock)
